sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet for Easy Job office game. Transparent background. ONE consistent large broad-shouldered human HR office employee, black polo shirt, small white HR ID badge, black trousers, sunglasses, short dark hair, visible warm skin, no hat. Club-bouncer build but friendly cartoon slapstick, no weapons, no guard uniform. Match attached reference cast's chibi proportions, 1px dark navy #2f3a4f outlines, crisp pixel shapes, flat 2-tone shading, no gradients or shadows. Sheet EXACTLY 4 columns by 10 rows, all 40 cells same spacing and character scale, no grid or labels. Each eventual frame is 48x72; body roughly 32px wide and 56px tall, feet at bottom of each cell. Rows 1,2,3 walking front,left,back four steps each. Row4 reach both arms forward four progressive poses. Row5 grab left 2 poses then grab right 2 poses, palms at shoulder height. Row6 carry-walk left four steps, empty hands held forward and up, leans back. Row7 carry-walk front four steps. Row8 carry-walk back four steps. Row9 comic toss windup, release, follow-through, relaxed. Row10 dust hands together two poses, two idle poses. No carried person. Palette only #2f3a4f #2a2f38 #444b57 #3b4560 #f3c9a5 #e2b089 #8d5a3b #ffffff #dfe5e4. No realism, injury, violence, guns or weapons.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached Easy Job compound-night pixel art background. Preserve the exact panoramic composition, architecture, palm silhouettes, casino skyline, concrete wall and closed corrugated gate, same night brightness and 1px navy pixel outlines, 32px game grid scale and flat two-tone pixel art. Add a thin tiled coil of razor wire along the top of the foreground compound wall, warm wall-mounted lamps on the piers and more cream lit dorm windows. No people, guards, barred windows, weapons, violence, text labels, gradients, realistic texture or glow. Keep top-down three-quarter RPG camera, not isometric. Entire final canvas 768x224 aspect 24:7, exact existing layout, no border, transparent background beyond image footprint. Only palette #2f3a4f #c9d8d4 #bfcfcb #aebdb9 #e3ece9 #8fa3a0 #dfe5e4 #9aa8ad #b7c4c8 #2a2f38 #444b57 #3b4560 #c8322f #9e2522 #fff3c4 #1d2747 #6a4bd8 #e0559c #3fd2e8 #f6d2b2 #f3c9a5 #e2b089 #c98f6a #8d5a3b #ffffff.
